# rustfs_iam_policy (Data Source)

Fetch the details of a single canned IAM policy by name

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "rustfs_iam_policy" "readwrite" {
  name = "readwrite"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the canned policy.

### Read-Only

- `statement` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--statement))
- `version` (String) Policy version (2012-10-17).

<a id="nestedatt--statement"></a>
### Nested Schema for `statement`

Read-Only:

- `action` (Set of String)
- `effect` (String)
- `resource` (Set of String)
